name: Versus Split
description: A head-to-head Short: the screen splits diagonally into coral and blue halves that slam in from the sides, a black VS badge with a yellow ring, two characters drawn in code, and stat bars that race toward each other row by row with a winner crown.
best_use_cases: Stat-by-stat battles with a running score
style: Diagonal coral (#ff6b4a) vs blue (#2b6cff) split, black VS badge with yellow ring, big white Anton names, dark stat panel with bars racing out from the centre, counting values and a yellow crown on the winner. Fight-night beat, slams, counter ticks and a crowd cheer for the verdict.
